en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a river port with several steam-powered boats and barges on a calm, wide river. Smoke billows from the funnels of two paddle steamers in the center. On the left bank there is an industrial facility with cranes and a red-roofed building partly visible behind trees. The sky has a pastel gradient from light orange near the horizon to blue above. The caption "Gröba-Riesa." appears in the upper left corner.
